whenToUse: A fundraising campaign, pre-order threshold or membership drive: raised against the goal with backers and the deadline.
Limited runs and drops: units left against the run, with low stock and sold out stated.
avoidWhen: Task or upload progress — use progress.
A single KPI against a target in a dashboard — use stat or gauge.
a11y: Built on Progress: role="progressbar" with one localized aria-valuetext sentence; the large figure is aria-hidden so it is not read twice.
Days left render after hydration (or from `now`), so server and client markup agree.
